summary: Checked that the page background is the same color (#f2f2f2) everywhere. First run FAILED: the html element was still white rgb(255,255,255) on inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao, inscricao-realizada and pagamento-pix at both 1920 and 390. Body was correct (242). Cause: each of these 5 pages has its own inline <style> 'html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:#fff!important}'. That rule loads after pages.css, and the new 'html{...}' rule in pages.css has the same weight (specificity 0,0,1), so the inline rule won. Tester fixed it with one change to the selector in pages.css (line 43): added 'html:not(#vn_a):not(#vn_b):not(#vn_c)'. After the fix, html and body are both rgb(242,242,242) on all 6 flow pages at 1920x800 and 390x844. On termos.html, html is transparent and body is 242; the browser then paints the whole page with the body color, so it looks the same. Earlier mobile fixes still hold at 390 on every flow page: no .periodoInscricoes, no .vn-sub, h3.vn-keep is 21px. The termos footer is static at 390 and fixed at 1920. Full flow termos -> Inscrever-se -> inscricao (filled form and uploaded documents) -> Continuar -> dados-inscricao works.

ui_bugs.issue: Inline <style> html,body{background:#fff!important} overrode the pages.css html rule. FIXED by tester with a more specific selector in pages.css

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove 'background:#fff !important' from the inline html,body style in inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao, inscricao-realizada and pagamento-pix.html. Not required, because pages.css now wins.
Optional: bump the pages.css cache version (it is still ?v=11) so returning users get the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: The inline html,body background:#fff!important rules in the flow pages conflict with the shared theme; keep the background in a single place.

context_for_next_testing_agent: When running mobile checks, set the 390 viewport BEFORE navigating: mobile-clean.js only acts at page load. Termos uses networkidle, which times out, so use domcontentloaded. To submit inscricao: type the CEP first (the CEP lookup clears the address fields), then fill the address and upload the DOC_FRENTE and DOC_VERSO files.
